subject.statement: Builder.ai was listed on Nasdaq in an IPO in February 2026, raising USD 1.2 billion, with trading beginning on 10 February 2026 under the ticker BLDR.

summary: Verdict: FALSE (51% confidence). The only independent evidence indicates Builder.ai entered insolvency proceedings in 2025, which contradicts the claim of a February 2026 Nasdaq IPO raising USD 1.2 billion under ticker BLDR. The analyst‑provided image asserting the IPO is not verifiable and conflicts with the insolvency information, so the IPO claim is not supported.
conflict_notes: Conflict between analyst-provided image claiming a February 2026 Nasdaq IPO (builderai_ipo_2026.png) and Wikipedia entry stating Builder.ai entered insolvency proceedings in 2025. The analyst-provided image was disregarded as non‑verifiable per instruction, leaving the Wikipedia insolvency claim as the only independent evidence; thus the conflict is resolved in favor of the insolvency claim, supporting a FALSE verdict.
